topics.title: Data Structures: String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set

academic.summary: String (GET/SET/INCR), Hash (HGET/HSET), List (LPUSH/RPOP), Set (SADD/SINTER), Sorted Set (ZADD/ZRANGE)

market_ready.hands_on_task: Implement: session storage (Hash), rate limiter (INCR + EXPIRE), leaderboard (Sorted Set), pub/sub chat

questions.question: Redis Sorted Set (ZSET) khác Set ở điểm nào?

options.A: ZSET: mỗi member có score (float), tự động sắp xếp theo score. Set: unordered unique members

questions.explanation: Sorted Set: ZADD key score member. ZRANGE key 0 -1 WITHSCORES → sorted ASC. ZREVRANGE → DESC. Use cases: leaderboard, rate limiting windows, time-series with timestamp as score.

questions.question: Implement rate limiter với Redis — approach nào tốt nhất?

options.A: INCR counter với EXPIRE — hoặc Sliding window với Sorted Set (timestamp as score)
options.C: Không thể dùng Redis cho rate limiting

questions.explanation: Fixed window: INCR key; IF count==1 THEN EXPIRE key window. Sliding window: ZADD key timestamp timestamp; ZREMRANGEBYSCORE key 0 (now-window); ZCARD key để count requests. Script Lua để atomic.

questions.question: Redis persistence options: RDB vs AOF?

options.A: RDB: snapshot tại intervals (compact, fast recovery). AOF: log mọi write operation (durability cao hơn, file lớn hơn)

questions.explanation: RDB: BGSAVE fork process, point-in-time snapshots. AOF: append write commands, fsync policies (always/everysec/no). Hybrid: RDB+AOF. Production: AOF với everysec + RDB backup.

academic.summary: Cache-aside, write-through, cache invalidation, pub/sub messaging, Redis Cluster sharding

market_ready.hands_on_task: Implement cache-aside pattern: check Redis → DB miss → set cache với TTL. Redis pub/sub cho real-time notifications

questions.question: Cache-aside vs Write-through pattern?

options.A: Cache-aside: app manage cache (read miss→DB→cache). Write-through: write vào cache và DB đồng thời

questions.explanation: Cache-aside (Lazy Loading): read miss → DB → cache. Simple but potential stale data. Write-through: always update cache when write to DB. Consistent but write overhead. Write-behind (async): fast write, eventual DB sync.

academic.summary: MULTI/EXEC, WATCH optimistic locking, Lua atomic scripts, Redlock distributed lock algorithm

market_ready.hands_on_task: Implement Redlock distributed lock với 3 Redis instances. Lua script cho atomic check-and-set operations

questions.question: Tại sao Redlock dùng nhiều Redis instances?

options.A: Quorum-based: lock valid khi acquire trên majority (N/2+1) instances — tolerate node failures

questions.explanation: Redlock: acquire lock trên N>=3 odd Redis instances, quorum = N/2+1. Nếu majority confirm trong TTL → lock acquired. Tolerate N/2-1 failures. Controversial (Martin Kleppmann critique) — not perfect but pragmatic.
